svg.title: LSD: Dream Emulator decompilation progress map
svg.desc: Rectangle area is code bytes. Every game function is matching C. Dark green: still named by address. Mid green: named, with unknown fields or locals inside. Light green: every name in its body is ours. The bar below places the game code in the whole executable, beside Sony's libraries. Open the file to hover each function.

g.text: SLPS_015.56 rebuilt byte for byte · c28230c · 1,447 game functions, 208,352 code bytes
1,404 of 1,447 functions use only our names
